processing.note: The source categories identify Keith Monks Archivist Duo Omni, RCM Mk. IX, and ELP LT-2XA. Detailed restoration, pitch adjustment and equalisation are not documented.

composition.value: Underlying song and Pushkin text are public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: Rimsky-Korsakov died in 1908 and Pushkin in 1837; the song was published in 1898. No rights in an unidentified modern edition are asserted.

recording.value: territorial — European public domain; first published 1928
recording.note: Allowed on documented publication before 1963: the former 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. US recording status is not established. Commons’ PD-old-70 composition tag is not treated as a recording licence; the upstream item contains no non-commercial restriction. Upstream worldwide/US expiry assertions are not adopted.
